content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_00218 If an I-PDU is started by Com_IpduGroupStart with parameter Initialize set to true, the AUTOSAR COM module shall additionally to [SWS_Com_00787] initialize the fol- lowing attributes of this I-PDU: 1. the data of the I-PDU as defined in [SWS_Com_00217] 2. the shadow buffers of included signal groups 3. old_value of the filtering mechanisms for each signal to the ComSignalInit- Value 4. ComTxModeTimePeriod and ComTxModeTimeOffset of I-PDUs in PERIODIC or MIXED transmission mode
